notes: This manifest is the contract between the payload build and the app.
packaged=false means the runtime is NOT embedded in this APK build and the app will report NOT INSTALLED. It never falls back to a remote server.
scripts/prepare-runtime.sh (run by .github/workflows/runtime-build.yml) fills in versions, digests and packaged=true once the payloads are built and verified.
Node.js is cross-compiled for Android (--dest-os=android --shared) and shipped as libnode.so + libnoderun.so in jniLibs; n8n and OpenCode run as JavaScript payloads on that Node.

n8n.license: SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md (sustainable use licence - review before distributing a payload)

opencode.source: https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode (npm opencode-ai 1.18.30 is a launcher for prebuilt binaries; the payload is bundled from source for Node)
